homeHint: Choose Call or Send location. Your phone asks you to confirm the call or send the SMS.
sosA11yHint: Opens Call and Send location options for your emergency contact.
disclaimer: SafeStep does not alert anyone for you. This places a call from your phone to your emergency contact.
calledBody: Confirm the call on your phone. If the dialer did not open, try again.
failedBody: Please dial {{number}} on your phone now.

timeline.title: What happens when you tap
timeline.callNamed: Choose Call or Send location to {{name}}
timeline.callGeneric: Choose Call or Send location to your emergency contact

none.title: Add an emergency contact first
none.loggedOut: Log in and add someone you trust. SOS will call them from your phone.
none.noContacts: Add someone you trust. SOS will call them from your phone.

sms.choose: How would you like to get help?
sms.draftReady: SMS draft ready. Review it and press Send in your Messages app. We cannot confirm whether it was sent.
sms.sharingNote: Keep this page open and return after sending. Location updates can pause while Messages is open or your phone is locked. Sharing expires after 30 minutes.
sms.costNote: Your mobile plan’s SMS charges may apply. The recipient can open the tracking link in a browser.
sms.ended: This location share has ended, expired, or is unavailable.
sms.stale: Updates have paused. This is the last received location, not a confirmed current position.
sms.viewerNote: Only the latest shared position is shown. Updates depend on the sender’s connection and their tracking page remaining active.

errors.account: Log in with a real account to share your location.
errors.location: Location is unavailable. Use HTTPS, enable location services, and allow this site to access your location. You can still use Call.
errors.network: Location sharing could not be updated. Check your connection; the recipient may only see the last received position.
errors.composer: The SMS app could not be opened. Use Open SMS draft or copy the message below.
errors.stop: Updates have stopped on this device, but the server could not confirm ending the link. Try Stop sharing again; otherwise the link expires automatically.
errors.expired: Location sharing has expired. Choose Send location to create a new SMS and tracking link.
